verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official CLI for working with its APIs from the terminal, explicitly for scripts and continuous integration [algolia-docs-2]. It has browser-based sign-in [algolia-docs-3], application management commands [algolia-docs-30] and cross-platform builds [algolia-docs-62], and the probe confirms the docs exist [algolia-probe-5]. It is AI-native through an official 'algolia-cli' agent skill that manages indices, settings, rules and synonyms via the CLI [algolia-docs-50]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented agent-friendly specifics such as machine-readable (JSON) output or non-interactive API-key authentication for headless agents.
